Stated Claim / Post Context:
City Council set to grill NYPD officials over NYC crime trends

New York City councilmembers are scheduled to grill top-ranking police officials — notably without Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch — in what is gearing up to be a hourslong hearing in City Hall Wednesday.
